header.name: Verdant Bot 1.2.7 • Bedrock 1.21.114 • Nether Speedrun World-Class
header.description: Verdant 1.2.7 - autonomous simulated player for Bedrock 1.21.114. Spawns a real GameTest player and drives it with a purpose-built decision stack: starter kit, auto survival, mining (staircase/corridor + deep branch/vein), crafting and smelting with rollback-safe transfers, foraging and food strategy, melee combat with retreats, escape and water survival, exploration, structure loot, village-first food/beds, iron golem fights, nether prep (bucket, obsidian, portal, ignition) and a speedrun director; plus persistent memory, night camping, death recovery and 80 survival scenarios. Honest by construction: nothing fabricated or teleported, dig checks hazards, shelters stay reopenable, owner-gated, circuit breaker on repeated faults. Verified offline by node tools/run-all.mjs (4 gates + unit + perf suites over 33 modules).
